name: Sanada Yukimura
source:
Hobby: Playing with his pet wolf Muramasa
Special Skill: Having Nimble Fingers
Charm Point: Chivalrous Tsundere

A man who seeks revenge against Nobunaga. He is a devoted follower of Shingen Takeda, who he met when he was young. Brash and assertive, he's also surprisingly awkward when it comes to women.

"Make sure you stay behind me. I promise to protect you."

[from the app]
